# Core Implementations

> Core Implementations helps growing businesses automate manual, repetitive work (data entry, quoting, reporting, and customer communication) using Claude, ChatGPT, and custom AI built around the tools businesses already use (QuickBooks, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, and more). Based in Houston, Texas, serving businesses of any size or industry.

## Company

- [About Us](https://coreimplement.com/about): Founders and background of Core Implementations.
- [Contact](https://coreimplement.com/contact): Book a free consultation or send a message.
- [Privacy Policy](https://coreimplement.com/privacy): How Core Implementations collects, uses, and protects information.
- [Terms of Service](https://coreimplement.com/terms): Terms governing use of the Core Implementations website.

## Services

- [Business Process Automation](https://coreimplement.com/services#business-process-automation): Automating repetitive workflows and integrating existing business tools.
- [AI-Powered Customer Communication](https://coreimplement.com/services#ai-powered-customer-communication): AI voice agents and AI-managed email for calls and customer messages.
- [Custom AI Software & Integrations](https://coreimplement.com/services#custom-ai-software-integrations): Custom dashboards, portals, and internal tools connected to existing software.
- [AI-Powered Marketing & Growth](https://coreimplement.com/services#ai-powered-marketing-growth): AI-driven content, ad optimization, and lead generation.
